coupling.note: Searched for ideals, prime/maximal ideals, Noetherian conditions, polynomial rings, localization, Groebner bases. The only hits are lattice cryptography (module rank, MSC 11/94) and well-founded recursion. Z-sets are Z-modules, but no commutative-ring structure or ideal theory is used anywhere in tree.

targets.claim: Walsh-Hadamard transform as Pontryagin duality on the locally compact abelian group (GF(2)^4, XOR): characters, orthogonality, and the convolution theorem in the exact 43A form (pointwise product in the primal = XOR-convolution in the dual).

Univalence and path types (MSC 55U35 abstract/axiomatic homotopy theory); the file explicitly refuses the stronger claim that the substrate IS a homotopy type, which is why it is usable as a target at all.
IJoinSemilattice / ISemilattice as first-class interfaces — join as least upper bound is literally the CRDT merge, so the whole convergence story is order theory (MSC 06A12).
The G-Set is the free join-semilattice on its element set; monotone growth under union is the partial order.
Routh's mass-ratio stability threshold mu_crit = (1 - sqrt(23/27))/2 for the L4/L5 Lagrange points of the restricted three-body problem (MSC 70F15), used as a literal constant and pinned by tests.
Second independent draw of the same tradition, answered the same way: the G-Set CRDT is still the sharpest 68M14 target. Recorded to show mentions rising while depth does not.
Blaschke factor (z-a)/(1-conj(a)z) as a declared primitive of the arithmetic interface — the canonical automorphism of the unit disc (MSC 30D/30J).

coupling.note: No normed/Banach space, no dual space, no completeness argument, no weak topology in tree. The nearest structure is the Banach fixed-point theorem in src/Core/Fixpoint.fs, which is MSC 47H10/54H25 (fixed-point theory), not 46. Recorded as a null rather than stretched to fit.

targets.claim: The E8 root system and its reflection group — root norms, rank, and the Killing-Cartan identification used to separate D4+D4 from F4 by invariants rather than by root count.
The E8 lattice itself: the even unimodular rank-8 lattice whose automorphism group is the Weyl group W(E8).
Orbits of the pure CHIP-8 step map classified by their ending: lambda=1 fixed points vs lambda>1 cycles vs open-at-bound — MSC 37C25 fixed and periodic points, made into a verdict type.
Contraction mapping and iteration to a unique fixed point — the convergence argument the whole s = f(s) discipline rests on.

coupling.note: No match for Navier-Stokes, Reynolds number, turbulence, vorticity, or incompressible flow anywhere in src/. The word 'flow' in tree is control flow and flow control (backpressure), which is 90B/68M, not 76.

targets.claim: Landauer's bound (1961) as a formal cost contract: erasing one bit costs at least kT ln 2, and cumulative heat is proven to dominate cumulative bits erased.
Finite-time thermodynamics: thermodynamic length L as the finite-time excess numerator, with tau* = L/sqrt(alpha) minimising L^2/tau + alpha*tau by AM-GM.
G-Set CRDT: idempotent, commutative, associative union giving coordination-free replica convergence (MSC 68M14 distributed systems).
A one-parameter convex cost C(tau) = L^2/tau + alpha*tau minimised in closed form — MSC 90C25 convex programming, applied to commit cadence.
Bounded queue with a degree-of-parallelism knob and priority service discipline — MSC 90B22 queueing / 90B35 scheduling.
